Details & Features
The MINI-VERTICUS series sets new standards in technology and ergonomics. Equipped with the latest B-CONTROL control system, the MINI-VERTICUS is quiet, efficient and particularly maintenance-friendly. The well thought-out arrangement of the operating elements guarantees intuitive operation from the front. The integrated condensate tank with increased capacity is automatically monitored and signals when it needs to be emptied. Its robust construction and optimised components make it the ideal solution for continuous use under high-pressure conditions up to 420 bar.
B-CONTROL MICRO compressor control system
The B-CONTROL MICRO is a modern, user-friendly compressor control system with a color display that intelligently manages and reliably monitors all basic functions. Interaction between the user and the control system is intuitive and straightforward, with information displayed in clear text. Various languages are available. External signal transmitters can be connected at any time, and operation in a networked system or with an external display is also possible.

Details & Features
The B-MASTER MINI, MIDI, and MAXI filling panels are purpose-built for the filling of compressed air cylinders used in paintball sports. They enable safe and efficient filling of bottles ranging from 0.8 to 1.9 liters at 200 or 300 bar. The system is designed for external mounting and can be expanded using T-pieces – ideal for multi-table setups.
The rugged filling coupling with integrated check valve fits all standard paintball nipples and prevents the hose from whipping if triggered without a connected marker. An integrated silencer reduces noise when venting the hose.
In the B-MASTER MAXI, the safety valve is included as standard; for the MINI and MIDI variants, it is available as an option.

in breathing air systems and an undisputed leading position in industrial applications, supported by a global service network.
What
is the I26 series used for?
The I26 series comprises water-cooled high-pressure compressors for the compression of air and nitrogen. It is used whenever these gases need to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures and supplied over long periods in continuous operation. Typical applications include industrial compressed air and nitrogen supply, process gas systems, research and development, test facilities and applications with permanent high-pressure demand where thermal stability and high operational reliability are required.
What
performance ranges does the I26 series cover?
The I26 high-pressure compressors achieve final pressures from 90 to 420 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 2,200 to 3,300 litres per minute, depending on configuration, inlet pressure and operating conditions. This makes the series suitable for medium to high-capacity industrial applications in continuous operation.
What
characterises the technical concept of the I26 series?
